name: cold14-b3
title: PR604's cold-ended construction with a second cold low-frame end per factory block (ColdBeyond v3) and ColdSupply's E1 entering pair, at a free dispatch (jp8 x60, atm3 x12) with an exact per-time-Hall owner map (exact-window MIP, RINS)
summary: Provider menu {ck, atm3, jp8}: PR604's chains ending with `cold_end`, whose recipes (ColdBeyond v3) add per factory block a second cold end (S b.9 at U_b) to PR604's S b.10 end plus ColdSupply's E1 entering pair; the step allowlist gains frame-[] target writes and forward absorptions (PROOF-NOTE.md). Owner search: ColdBeyond's copy of ColdOwner's recipe.py (only its paths differ) driving solve_h.py (PR569 nominate_width7.py adapted; objective sum F(r) = r*(73/r)^b, b = 0.001635), with provider locals of the v3 words: (1) aggregate free-dispatch LP over the menu (crossover, tight 3), pattern-seeded from the E1free map -> LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json (bound 523259.328281); (2) dispatch = per-time argmax of the LP selections -> DISPATCH.json (jp8 x60, atm3 x12); (3) exact-window LP (crossover) at that dispatch over base + AGG patterns with weight >= 0.01 -> LP-PATTERNS-EX.json (523259.425227); (4) exact-window MIP, RINS around the EX vertex (slack 2/1), gap 1e-9, 240 s: time limit, obj 523259.513408, bound 523259.425227, gap 1.69e-7; (5) mkplan.py --locals (final admitted locals): PLAN = solve output with the provider registry re-derived from the admitted locals and profile/assignment_sha256 recomputed from the map (reproduces data/PLAN.json byte for byte). The map is admitted by the package's verifier chain, not by the search.

dispatch.origin: at the free dispatch jp8 ×60, atm3 ×12 (per-time argmax of the aggregate free-dispatch hosting LP over {ck, atm3, jp8}; ck is never selected)
dispatch.plan_rule: the window MIP's PLAN with the provider registry re-derived from the admitted provider locals and `profile`/`assignment_sha256` recomputed from the map (ColdOwner mkplan.py)

owners.origin: an exact per-time-Hall exact-window MIP solution (RINS around the exact-window LP vertex; 240 s time limit, relative gap 1.69e-7)
owners.warm_owners_origin: the E1free map (`data/OWNERS.json.gz` of research/complex-571-cold14-e1, byte for byte), used only to seed the aggregate LP's patterns

search.tool: ColdBeyond recipe.py (ColdOwner's, paths changed) -> solve_h.py (PR569 global/nominate_width7.py adapted)
search.dispatch_rule: per time t: argmax over providers of LP-PATTERNS-AGG selections[t]

lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json: aggregate free-dispatch LP relaxation over {ck, atm3, jp8} (crossover, tight 3), pattern-seeded from the E1free map
lp_inputs.DISPATCH.json: the dispatch {time: provider} = per-time argmax of the aggregate LP selections
lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-EX.json: exact-window LP relaxation (crossover) at that dispatch over the base patterns plus aggregate-LP patterns with weight >= 0.01
lp_inputs.WARM-PLAN.json: the E1free PLAN matching WARM-OWNERS.json.gz (pattern seeding of the aggregate LP)
lp_inputs.TEMPLATE-PLAN.json: the PLAN of ColdBeyond's working package (PR604's dispatch ck ×44, atm3 ×22, jp8 ×6), whose windows/order/registry template the nominator reuses
